name: claimsetu
description: ClaimSetu — India's AI-native health insurance claims platform

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix web && npm run db:setup
scripts.db:setup: npm run --prefix server prisma:migrate && npm run --prefix server db:seed
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix web"
